transport: POST JSON { action, payload, token }. Response { ok, data } or { ok:false, error, code }. Do not connect this contract to a live spreadsheet from tests.
monthKey: YYYY-MM. Inputs 2026-11 and 2026-11-01 canonicalize to 2026-11. Sheet cells are written with a leading apostrophe so they stay text.
auth: Missing auth sheet, empty users, bad password, disabled user, or missing token all fail closed.
roles: 顾问 may write. 客户 may read and submit plan feedback and privacy acknowledgement. Other roles cannot write.

cash.amount: Positive magnitude. Zero, negative, and non-numeric rejected with CASH_AMOUNT. Direction is 收入 or 支出.
cash.boundary: 2000.00 and month total 20000.00 are accepted. 2000.01 and 20000.01 are rejected with CASH_LIMIT and recorded under rejectedCash, not in cashItems.
cash.idempotency: payload.clientRequestId replays the original cash item or the original rejection.

formalBooks: postFourStatements returns OPENING_UNCONFIRMED unless config.openingConfirmed is explicitly true (sheet column 期初已确认). Completion, bank balance, and no unfinished lines are also required. previewFourStatements does not persist.
